name: Sasayama Miyuki
source:
A woman who's always scolding her mischievous son. However, she's a gentle woman who truly loves him. Though she's normally quite strong-willed and tough, she gives in easily when pressured. Her sex drive has only been growing recently, but her husband is unable to answer her desires. She's renowned around the neighborhood for her good looks.
[From DLsite English]
